name: Govillje Virtual Try-On
author: GoVillje

sections.description:
Govillje Virtual Try-On brings a high-end virtual wardrobe and mix-and-match try-on experience to your WooCommerce store. Empower your customers to visualize outfits, match different apparel combinations, and save products to their wishlist directly from a sleek, beautiful canvas.

Features

  • Interactive Dresser Canvas: Dynamic apparel try-on canvas.
  • WooCommerce Product Tab Integration: Configure custom canvas coordinates, layers, and categories on any standard or variable product.
  • WooCommerce Variations Support: Match different colors, sizes, and attributes seamlessly.
  • User Wishlist Integration: Quick wishlisting directly inside the try-on screen.
  • Premium Aesthetics: Stunning responsive UI featuring a modern, premium responsive layout.

Source Code & Build Instructions

The compiled assets (govillje-try-on-public.js, govillje-try-on-admin.js, govillje-try-on-runtime.js, and govillje-try-on-style.css) are generated from the included source code inside the public/app/ and admin/app/ directories.
The source code is included directly within the plugin package.

To modify the source code and compile the production assets locally:
1. Navigate to the plugin directory in your terminal.
2. Run npm install to install the build dependencies.
3. Run npm run build to compile the optimized React assets.

Third Party / External Services

This plugin utilizes the Freemius SDK to deliver seamless software updates, secure licensing verification, and opt-in diagnostic insights.

  • What it does: Facilitates automatic plugin updates and connects with the licensing server when upgrading features.
  • What data is sent: Only when the user explicitly opts in, the plugin securely transmits the website URL, administrator email address, active language, and the PHP/WordPress version.
  • Terms of Service: https://freemius.com/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://freemius.com/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the govillje-virtual-try-on folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or upload the ZIP file directly via the WordPress Admin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the try-on attributes and coordinates inside the “Govillje Try-On” tab on any WooCommerce product.
sections.faq:
Does it support variable products?

Yes! It fully integrates with WooCommerce product variations and custom transparent images.

Is it mobile-responsive?

Yes! The try-on canvas and widget are fully optimized for all screen sizes and mobile touch inputs.
